title: N-terminal acetyaltion of Human JunB in yeast expressing all N-terminal acetyltransferases, no NatA enzyme or no NatB enzyne
projectDescription: Define the N-terminal status of overexpressed human JUNB in WT yeast strain, NAA10 Δ strain and NAA20 Δ strain.
sampleProcessingProtocol: WT yeast strains, NAA10 Δ strain and NAA20 Δ strain were transfected with JUNB-FLAG and grown in -URA medium until reached exponential growth, then harvested. The cells were lysed with acid washed beads and lysis buffer before JUNB-FLAG was immunoprecipitated using FLAG-trap agarose beads. IP samples were further procesed for LC-MS/MS analysi.  IP beads were resuspended in incubation buffer supplemented with DTT for 10 min at 95 °C. Cysteines were alkylated by CAA. Protein samples were digested overnight using Arg-C. The digestion was stopped by TFA. The peptides were desalted using an oasis plate, before analysed by LC-MS/MS. See paper for further details.
dataProcessingProtocol: Thermo Proteome Discoverer 2.5.0.400 was used to analyse the LC-MS/MS data.
